mission: Name the Jacen pattern in Torin and attempt to break through before the turn becomes inevitable.
why_now: The Jacen pattern in Torin has crystallized after seventeen chapters of evidence. Ben's GAG conversation with Desh (Ch 11) provided the emotional framework to name what he's seeing.
conflict: Ben vs. the recognition he can't unsee
turning_point: Ben names the pattern: 'I've watched someone I loved make every argument you're making.' Torin dismisses gently. Desh confirms with a look. The turn is coming.
emotional_trajectory: The pattern repeats through good people doing what they believe is necessary
notes: Ben has named the pattern internally. Desh confirms silently. Ben confronts Torin partially: 'I've watched someone I loved make every argument you're making.' Torin dismisses gently. Kael observes from a conscript's pattern-recognition.
